## Shikigami (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 CE Small outsider (evil, goblin, oni, shapechanger)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6  
 


**Defense**

 

**AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)

 **Immune** cold, poison; **Resist** electricity 10; **SR** 13  
 


**Offense**

 **Melee** 2 claws +3 (1d3) or greatclub +3 (1d8)

 **Languages** Abyssal, Giant, Goblin, Kaidanese
